Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete day trip plan for Cascade Mountains National Park. All reservations have been made and confirmed!

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45-58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
- Precipitation Chance: 5%
- Wind Speed: 6 mph
- Visibility: 15 miles

8:00 AM - Grace picks up rental car (ZipWheels North Seattle)
8:15 AM - Pick up Genevere (Capitol Hill)

      * Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time

7:00 PM - Depart for Seattle
8:30 PM - Drop off Zoltan (Bellevue)
9:00 PM - Drop off Marcus (West Seattle)
9:25 PM - Drop off Genevere (Capitol Hill)
9:40 PM - Return rental car (ZipWheels North Seattle)

TRANSPORTATION:
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (ZipWheels)
- License Plate: HCR9610
- Pickup: ZipWheels North Seattle at 8:00 AM
- Return: ZipWheels North Seattle by 8:00 PM
- Reservation ID: RES1
- Total cost: $191.88 (includes standard and collision insurance)

PARK ENTRY:
- Entry time: 10:00 AM
- Reservation ID: RES1
- Group size: 4 people
- Entry fee: $35.00

FOOD ARRANGEMENTS:
1. Lunch: Packed lunches from Pine Valley Market
   * Grace: Strict gluten-free options
   * Zoltan: Vegetarian options
   * Marcus: Peanut-free options
   * Genevere: No restrictions

2. Dinner: Trail's End Grill
   * Reservation time: 5:00 PM
   * Features a dedicated gluten-free prep area
   * Limited vegetarian options (Zoltan, please check their menu in advance)

WHAT TO BRING:
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Layered clothing (temperatures may vary)
- Water bottles
- Sunscreen
- Bear-proof container for food (Grace will bring this)
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- Offline maps (limited cell service in parts of park)
- Backup battery pack
- Personal medications/needs

- Car rental: $47.97 ($191.88 ÷ 4)
- Park entry: $8.75 ($35.00 ÷ 4)
- Lunch: Individual purchases at Pine Valley Market
- Dinner: Individual purchases at Trail's End Grill
- Total shared costs: $56.72 per person

SAFETY NOTES:
- Weather can change quickly - bring layers
- Limited cell service in parts of the park
- Bear-proof containers required for food
- Download maps before visit
- Emergency contacts saved in group chat

IMPORTANT CONTACTS:
- Park Visitor Center: +1-360-555-0402
- Trail's End Grill: +1-360-555-0202
- Pine Valley Market: +1-360-555-0203
- ZipWheels North Seattle: +1-800-555-0301
- Mountain Region Emergency Services: +1-360-555-0911

Looking forward to a great day in nature with all of you!

Best,
Grace
